big: A PMS shows 28% a year. Sounds great. But over what period, gross or net of fees, time-weighted or money-weighted, against which benchmark? A track record without those answers is only a headline.

lines: How do I avoid being fooled?

Ask whether returns are time-weighted or money-weighted, gross or net, and for what period. Use the right benchmark over the same period. Look for consistency over many years, and at the worst fall, not only the best year. Beware survivorship: closed products vanish, leaving winners. And ask for the strategy's performance, not the best client account.
